title: Composition for the specified internal coefficient extension
statement: Let B be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], let S and X be Noetherian schemes, and let $b:T\to S$ and $a:S\to X$ be immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For every internal B_T-module M [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the specified closure-factorization extensions [lem-sfb-coefficient-heart-locally-closed-extension] satisfy $a_!b_!M\cong(b\mathbin{\gg}a)_!M$. This is an objectwise isomorphism on the underived internal module categories, with no lattice or filtration assertion.

source.place: Proof (1), stratified integral lattices and their extension-by-zero filtration

proof.text: Present each specified closure extension as generatorExtension of the open-then-closed GeneratorFactorization given by toImage and imageι. These are actual constructions, definitionally equal to the functors in the statement. The already proved generic helpers generatorExtension_support and generatorRestriction_isIso in the generator-tensor module apply to arbitrary modules and both factorization orders; no lisseness or tensor hypothesis is used.

source.place: Proof (1), stratified integral lattices and their extension-by-zero filtration

proof.text: Put P=b_!M and N=a_!P. To prove universal support of N on b≫a, take g:Y→X disjoint from that composite and form W=Y×_X S, with d:W→Y and t:W→S. The generic supported_pullback theorem gives support of g^*N on d. The morphism d is an immersion, so W is Noetherian. The fibre-product equation shows that t is disjoint from b. Thus t^*P=0 by support of b_!M. Pullback composition and the restriction isomorphism a^*N≅P identify d^*g^*N with t^*P. The generic supported_zero theorem then gives g^*N=0. This proves universal support on the composite.

source.place: Proof (1), stratified integral lattices and their extension-by-zero filtration

proof.text: Apply generatorExtension_reconstruct for the actual closure factorization of b≫a to obtain N≅(b≫a)_!((b≫a)^*N). Pullback composition, the restriction of a_!, and the restriction of b_! identify (b≫a)^*N with M. Apply the actual composite extension functor to this last isomorphism and compose. This is the requested isomorphism. The argument has no nonempty-source or nonzero-module assumption and retains the unit integral-model generation route.

theorem locallyClosedCoefficientExtension_composition
    (B : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj B] [IsCommMonObj B] {T S X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian X]
    (a : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion a] (b : T ⟶ S) [IsImmersion b]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj B T)) :
    Nonempty ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B a inferInstance).obj
        ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B b inferInstance).obj M) ≅
      (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B (b ≫ a) inferInstance).obj M)
